technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with extreme overbought conditions and bullish oscillator crosses, but weakened by bearish intermediate structure (below 200-MA, below cloud) and declining volume—suitable for tactical entry with tight stops, not swing conviction.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 9 days away.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling (small amounts, 6+ months old) combined with market fear (36 VIX equivalent) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (349.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 9 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for LUV trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme overbought with stochastic bullish cross and Ichimoku TK cross-up provide short-term momentum entry signal near support (36.59), exploitable for tactical swing with tight stops.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below 200-EMA and 200-SMA with bearish 20/50 structure, declining volume, crisis VIX (349.6), high earnings risk (9 days), zero fundamental conviction, and macro headwinds (flat yield curve, rising dollar) make risk/reward unfavorable for swing conviction.
